counterfactual_missing_items: no definite mass shadow was found on mammogram
no obvious abnormal blood flow signal in the bilateral breasts
no vascular or nerve invasion seen on FNAC
decisive_items: irregular hypoechoic areas in the left breast
irregular mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast
Isodense soft tissue mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast
response.rationale: R1 directly aligns with the imaging and pathological evidence of a malignant breast mass, including irregular hypoechoic areas, an irregular mass on MRI, and an isodense soft tissue mass on PET-CT, all in the upper outer quadrant. R8 is a broad label that lacks the specificity of R1 and does not capture the detailed imaging features. R1 is the most likely specific diagnosis.

rejected.why: Weak support from only 'irregular mass' and 'heterogeneous fibro glandular'; mammogram finding of 'no definite mass shadow' contradicts a solid tumor like phyllodes.
Lymph node positivity is a staging feature, not a primary diagnosis; lacks direct evidence of the breast mass itself.
No raw support spans; absence of HER2 testing is not diagnostic and does not establish HER2-negative status.
Misinterprets AR (androgen receptor) as estrogen receptor; the IHC shows AR positivity, not ER, so this is an unsupported claim.
Benign diagnosis contradicted by multiple malignant features: irregular hypoechoic areas, patchy tortuous structure, and abnormal radioactive distribution.
